debugMenu.title: Debug menu (F1)
debugMenu.tooltip: Lets F1 open the effect tuning menu: strengths, tones, colours and Play buttons for every haptic, trigger and gyro effect.

gyroMode.title: Gyro control
gyroMode.tooltip: Off: no gyro. Full: tilt the controller to roll, pitch and yaw the ship (and the jetpack in zero gravity). Roll only: only the sideways tilt rolls, pitch and yaw stay on the right stick. Hold L3 and press R3 to set the current pose as level.
